Good day, ladies and gentlemen. Thank you for standing by, and welcome to Boqii's FY 2024 H1 Earnings Conference Call. Currently, all participants are in listen-only mode. Later, we will conduct a question and answer session, and instructions will follow at that time. As a reminder, we are recording today's call. If you have any objections, you may disconnect at this time. Now I will turn the call over to Elle, Boqii's Head of Investor Relations.
Elle Lai
Head of Investor Relations, Boqii
Thank you, operator, and thank you all for waiting for us to start the conference call. Good morning, everyone. Welcome to Boqii's FY 2024 H1 Earnings Conference Call. Today are Miss Lisa Tang, Co-CEO and CFO, as well as Mr. Lloyd Dai, our Financial VP. We released results earlier today. The earnings release is available on the SEC website.
A replay of the call will be available on the site later today. Before we continue, please note that today's discussion will contain forward-looking statements made under the safe harbor provisions of the US Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995. Forward-looking statements involve inherent risks and uncertainties. As such, the company's actual results may be materially different from the expectations expressed today. Further information regarding these and other risks and uncertainties is included in the company's public filings with the SEC.
The company does not assume any obligation to update any forward-looking statements except as required under applicable law. [Foreign language] Please note that certain financial measures that we use on this call, such as non-GAAP net loss, non-GAAP net loss margin, EBITDA and EBITDA margin, are expressed on a non-GAAP basis.
Our GAAP results and reconciliations of GAAP to non-GAAP measures can be found in our earnings press release. [Foreign language] Also, please be reminded that unless otherwise stated, all figures mentioned during the conference call are in Chinese RMB. [Foreign language] With that, let me now turn the call over to our Co-CEO and CFO, Ms.
Lisa Tang [Foreign language] Lisa, Over to you, Lisa。
Lisa Tang
Co-CEO and CFO, Boqii
Thank you Elle, and many thanks to everyone for joining the call today.
At the beginning of FY 2024, despite the challenges of market uncertainty, we made great strides in revenue mix enhancement and cost control, with high margin private labels showcasing its resilience and indirect costs also seeing a notable drop in amount and percentage to revenue, laying the foundation for a solid H1. [Foreign language] As part of the management team, we totally believe that we are moving in the right direction, and we maintain confidence in the development of China's pet industry.
We will continue to work diligently and passionately, and we will keep a keen eye on market dynamics and opportunities so that we can generate sustainable returns to our shareholders.
Let's pass the time to Elle to further update you on the operational and business developments in H 2024. [Foreign language]。
Elle Lai
Head of Investor Relations, Boqii
Thank you, Lisa. In fact, despite the uncertainties in the macroeconomy, China's pet economy continued to demonstrate its potentials. According to the latest report, the penetration rate of households owning pets in China is expected to continue its rising trend, reaching 22% in 2023. That number is still way behind that in the United States and Europe, suggesting substantial room for expansion.
By 2025, it is predicted that China's pet market will hit RMB 811.4 billion, representing a CAGR of 19.8% from 2021 to 2025. [Foreign language] All these reassure us that China's pet market is going to eventually rebound.
Hence, during H1, Boqii focuses on strengthening its market position, enhancing its brand profile, improving its user stickiness, refining its product offerings, and streamlining its business operation in preparation for the better wave in the future. [Foreign language] particular, customer loyalty will be the major growth driver for the group as the listed pet company.
In the meanwhile, we delivered satisfactory results for our private label.
Leveraging our extensive user data and excellent big data capability, we were able to optimize our private labels product offerings to better cater to pet parents' needs while reducing our carrying costs for non-performing SKUs. Although the group suffered a drop in overall GMV of private labels actually enjoyed an increase of 2.1% to RMB 212.9 million.
Its revenue contribution to overall revenue also rose from 17.8% to 26.4%, leading to a stable performance in gross margins and post-fulfillment margins, with gross margins standing firm at 20% and post-fulfillment margins enjoying an uptake of 170 basis points to 11.2%. As we grow as a brand along with the comprehensive content and customized product selection on offer, there was also rising user stickiness, which was reflected in the historic low CAC, down by 46% year over year to merely RMB 2.8.
Customer purchase frequency also increased from 1.32 last year to 1.34 this year, with growth seen across both new and existing customers. [Foreign language] Overall, we remain confident in our unique positioning in China's expanding pet market.
We have observed encouraging trends, including a significant rise in the number of pets and the increasing popularity of pet e-commerce, which bodes well for the future of us as the pet industry aggregator. We will continue our journey to establish a well-rounded ecosystem that delivers values to both pet parents and brand partners.
We are enthusiastic about building upon our leading position, hopefully creating a more resilient and impactful industry presence in the future. [Foreign language]
Lloyd Dai
Financial VP, Boqii
Thank you, Elle. In the following I'd like to share more on our financial performance for H1 FY 2024. We continue to execute our strategic adjustment and business optimization. [Foreign language] Our revenue for H1 FY 2024 was RMB 389.4 million, down by 34% year on year.
As a result of the worsening consumer sentiment and consumption downgrade in China, overall gross profit margin only decreased by 100 basis points to 20%, with gross profit reaching RMB 77.9 million. [Foreign language] We also made notable efforts on cost control as we improved the operational efficiency of our logistics services.
Fulfillment expenses as a percentage of revenue for the H1 decreased to 8.9% compared to 11.6% over last year. Fulfillment expenses decreased 49.4% to RMB 34.5 million.
That lays the foundation of an improving fulfillment margin, increasing from 9.5% last year to 11.2%. [Foreign language] S&M expenses decreased 28.6% to RMB 45.4 million, mainly due to the growing efficiency of customer acquisition from more cost-efficient channels. [Foreign language] G&A expenses were RMB 32.2 million compared to RMB 22.1 million for the H1 year of fiscal 2023.
The increase was mainly due to the increase in share-based compensation expenses. [Foreign language] came to a net loss of RMB 37.7 million in H1 FY 2024, and then non-GAAP net loss is RMB 34.2 million. We did FD Line and PIPE transaction in H1 2024, and the related expenses of RMB 7 million is recorded in net loss.
Also in H1, for the first time, we applied rule of ASC 326 of expected credit loss model to assess credibility of accounts receivable and other receivables. The expected credit loss of RMB 3 million is recorded in net loss. If excluding above two one-off effect, our net loss is RMB 27.7 million, representing an improvement of 6% compared to the same period of last year.
Non-GAAP net loss is RMB 24.2 million, representing an improvement of 15%, which show our capacity of breakeven in the short-term future. [Foreign language] On our financial position as of 30 September 2023, our effective debt to asset ratio stood at 39.5%.
Our total cash and cash equivalents were RMB 86.8 million, a drop of RMB 72.8 million, mainly due to a decrease of RMB 71 million in short-term borrowings compared to 31 March 2023. With no major CapEx foreseen and a strong credit line backup, we believe we are cash sufficient to support our operation and pursue new initiatives.
Besides, in September 2023, we entered into certain financing agreements with third-party investors, which will also provide us additional capital to explore our new business opportunities. [Foreign language] Moving forward, we will continue to strengthen our reach and control throughout the value chain.
This includes investments, collaborations, and strategic initiatives that would reinforce our closed-loop community.
We believe this approach would allow us to become not only the go-to place for pet parents, but also the go-to partner for brands, manufacturers, distributors and developers in China or soon to be in China. [Foreign language] Here wraps up my summary.
Let's now move on to the Q&A session. Operator.[Foreign language]
Operator
We will now begin the question and answer session. To ask a question you may press star then one on your touchtone phone. If you are using a speakerphone, please pick up your handset before pressing the keys. To withdraw your question, please press star then two. At this time we will pause momentarily to assemble the roster. Our first question today will come from Zoey Zhao of CICC. Please go ahead.
Zoey Zhao
Analyst, China International Capital Corporation
[Foreign language] non-GAAP [Foreign language]
Lloyd Dai
Financial VP, Boqii
[Foreign language] As described in our ER, the decrease is primarily due to the optimization of product mix related to our business strategy and the worsening consumer sentiment and consumption downgrade in China. In the future we expect our revenue to stabilize as we have finished the optimization of our product mix and as the economy recovers in the short term future. [Foreign language]
Zoey Zhao
Analyst, China International Capital Corporation
[Foreign language]
Lloyd Dai
Financial VP, Boqii
[Foreign language] break-even. We expect we will uh we will make the break-even in the short term future. Thank you. [Foreign language]
Zoey Zhao
Analyst, China International Capital Corporation
[Foreign language]
Operator
Our next question today will come from Lisa Liao of Jefferies. Please go ahead.
Lisa Lau
Equity research, Jefferies Financial Group
Hi management, thanks for taking my questions. This is Lisa Liao from Jefferies. Currently I have two questions for you. The first one, I want to learn about the company's delisting risk being resolved. This is the first one. Secondly, could we get more, like, some color from you about expenses such as S&M, G&A, and R&D, and any further reduction to expect in the future? [Foreign language] Thank you so much for taking my questions.
Lloyd Dai
Financial VP, Boqii
Okay, thank you. Thank you for your questions, and I will answer the first question. The company has already resolved the listing risk in October this year. We successfully transferred the listing from NYSE to NYSE American, where the company meets its compliance requirements and currently has no delisting risk.
Our total operating expenses of H1 were RMB 110 million, representing a decrease of 27.1% from RMB 154 million for the same period of last year. Especially for our fulfillment expenses. As we improve the operational efficiency, our logistics services, our fulfillment expenses as a percentage of total revenue for H1 has decreased to 8.9% compared to 11.6% of last year. The fulfillment expenses amount decreased 49.4% to RMB 34.5 million.
Our sales and marketing expenses were RMB 45.4 million, representing a decrease of 28.6% from RMB 63.5 million for H1 last year. Our G&A expenses were RMB 32.2 million compared to RMB 22.1 million for the same period last year, which is primarily due to the share-based compensation expenses increase. In the future as we continue to improve our logistics service efficiency and the customer acquisition efficiency, we expect that our operating expenses will be able to maintain the downward trend. The percentage of our revenue will also decrease in the short-term future. Thank you.
Operator
Thank you. Seeing no more questions in the queue, let me turn the call back to Ms. Elle Lai for closing remarks.
Elle Lai
Head of Investor Relations, Boqii
Thank you operator, and thank you all for participating in today's call. We appreciate your interest and look forward to reporting to you again on our progress in the next reporting period.
Operator
Thank you all again. This concludes the call. You may now disconnect.

Operator
Good day, ladies and gentlemen. Thank you for standing by, and welcome to Boqii's Q4 and Fiscal Year 2022 Earnings Conference Call. Currently all participants are in a listen-only mode. Later, we will conduct a question and answer session, and instructions will follow at that time. As a reminder, we are recording today's call. If you have any objections, you may disconnect at this time. Now I will turn the floor over to Mandy Luo, Boqii's IR manager. Mandy.
Mandy Luo
Investor Relations Manager, Boqii Holding
Thank you, operator, and good morning, everyone. Welcome to Boqii's Q4 and Fiscal Year 2022 Earnings Conference Call. Joining us today are Mr. Louis Liang, Chairman and CEO, Ms. Lisa Tang, Co-CEO and CFO, as well as Mr. Kai Fang, our Chief Strategy Officer.
[Non-English content]
We released results earlier today. The press release is available on the company's IR website at ir.boqii.com, as well as from Newswire Services. A replay of the call will be available on the site later today.
[Non-English content]
Before we continue, please note that today's discussion will contain forward-looking statements made under the Safe Harbor Provisions of the US Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995, involving inherent risks and uncertainties. As such, the company's actual results may be materially different from the expectations expressed today. Further information regarding this and other risks and uncertainties is included in the company's public filings with the SEC. The company does not assume any obligation to update any forward-looking statement except as required under the applicable law.
[Non-English content]
Please note that certain financial measures that we use on the call, such as adjusted net loss, adjusted net loss margin, EBITDA, and EBITDA margin, are expressed on a non-GAAP basis. Our GAAP results and reconciliations of GAAP to non-GAAP measures can be found in our earnings press release.
[Non-English content]
Also, please be reminded that unless otherwise stated, all figures mentioned during the call are in Chinese renminbi.
[Non-English content]
With that, let me now turn the call over to our Chairman and CEO, Mr. Louis Liang.
[Non-English content]
Over to you, Louis.
Louis Liang
Chairman and CEO, Boqii Holding
Okay. Thank you, Mandy, and many thanks to everyone for joining the call today. Fiscal year 2022 represents another challenging year for every one of us, whether you are from the US, China, or other parts of the world.
Before we start, no matter where you are, we appreciate your utmost confidence and support in Boqii, and we are glad that we were able to deliver encouraging results despite the frustrating COVID-19 pandemic. [Non-English content]. Reflecting on our operations, the supply chain disruption in China has no doubt created difficulties to our daily operations and put cost pressure on our fulfillment.
The regional lockdowns have also limited spending and affected the performance of the retail market.
Yet not all were negatives, as the lockdowns have lead to more time at home, more time with our beloved pets, and in return, delivering the sales of pet products ranging from daily necessities to healthcare, cleaning and grooming products. [Non-English content]. As a result, we were able to deliver a growth in GMV and revenue as well as improve our efficiency and expand our margins.
More importantly, we pride ourselves on delivering the required pet products to the large community despite lockdowns and supply chain disruptions.
That would not be possible if we are without our extensive in-house facilities and proven fulfillment capability. [Non-English content]. Looking back, we aim to be the reliable and trusted platform for pet parents since day one.
I believe we have done so, especially during the pandemic. We firmly believe our value is much more than a simple e-commerce business. As a leading pet platform with extensive product range, extensive outreaching channel, engaging community, and rich content, we have formed an ecosystem that can effectively connect pet parents and industry partners.
As we continue to grow in scale, we believe we are well-positioned to capture the recent products and serve needs for our pet parents as well as the marketing needs of the underserved SMEs. [Non-English content]. Financially, we are also moving closer to breakeven.
We have the utmost confidence that it will facilitate our value recovery and generate shareholder return. This would also provide us the capital to explore other opportunities and go beyond organic growth, adding further growth in paths to our business. [Non-English content]. Overall, we remain optimistic in our future development.
As senior management, we will continue to work with passion while keeping a keen eye on our operation as well as potential market opportunities in order to repay your trust and confidence.
Let me pass the time to our co-CEO Lisa to update you on our achievement during the year[Non-English content].
Lisa Tang
Co-Chief Executive Officer and CFO, Boqii Holding
Thank you, Louis. During the year, Boqii has put great effort to enhance its infrastructure.
They include improving our warehousing efficiency, expanding our online marketing capability, increasing our offline touchpoints, as well as reaching new collaborations with industry partners on hospital SaaS and pet-friendly stays, all in the hope to better serve our pet parents and branded partners. [Non-English content] Louis. [Non-English content]. Supported by our expanding SKU selection of 2,624 this year, a year over year growth of 33.5%, along with our growing brand equity and the introduction of new membership program, we were able to attract new users and boost retention during the year. Our active buyer has increased by 30.4% year over year to 5 million, with the number of orders also increased by 52.5% to 9.8 million for the year.
During the steady growth in the user base, our GMV and product sales also recorded satisfactory improvement increased by 19.4% and 17.4% respectively. [Non-English content].Our community engagement strategy also proved to be a success.
By offering users a platform to discuss, interact, and make purchases, which has become a go-to place for pet parents satisfying their product, service, and social needs. As 80% of pet parents in the PRC are first-generation pet owners, the useful pet care tips on our platform have also made us a good information hub.
[Non-English content]. Supported by our comprehensive or reaching channels, including APP, mini program, WeChat account and video channel that will give a sticky private traffic as well as third party traffic from search engine Tmall, JD, TikTok and [Non-English content], which will give a significant volume.
We are able to create a vibrant ecosystem characterized by high user stickiness, low retention costs, and high sales conversion.
Specifically, in fourth quarter, our customer acquisition cost has reached a new low of RMB5.7, which highlights the rising stickiness of both brands as well as the effectiveness of our strategy and measures for user acquiring, including the re-redemption membership program. [Non-English content]. This growing stickiness also allow us to do more for our industry partners.
As our branded partners often lack cost-effective marketing solutions due to the unspecified traffic mix of other e-commerce platforms, Boqii, with a group of closely tied pet parents, represents a much more effective marketing channel, especially for small- to midsize branded partners who have limited budgets in marketing. By riding on our rich user base, user database, and transaction data, we can also provide marketing intelligence to our branded partners so that we can make swift business decisions in this product mix and the supply chain.
As a result, we were able to deliver remarkable 5.3 times year-over-year increase in the revenue from online marketing and information services reaching RMB 49.1 million. [Non-English content]. We will also like to bring to your attention to that our private labels have made good progress during the year.
Its SKU grew by 69.4% to 5,643, and the revenue also grew by 15.8% year over year to RMB 42 million in this quarter. Gross profit margin of our private labels also reported a significant enhancement from 26.9% last Q4 to 33.4% this Q4.
[Non-English content]. Financially, the growth in the product sales and online marketing and information services have brought our revenue to a new high of RMB 1.19 billion, up 17.4% year over year.
As we continue to grow in scale and the GMV, as well as factoring in the high-margin nature of our online marketing business, our gross profit margin and the post-fulfillment margin also reported a record high of 20.5% and 9.2% for the year, respectively. Laying a solid foundation for future turnaround, we are confident that we will achieve breakeven in the coming quarters.
[Non-English content]. Now I will turn the call over to our CSO, Kai Fang, who will share more details on our financials and future strategy.
[Non-English content]
Kai Fang
Chief Strategy Officer, Boqii Holding
Thank you, Lisa. In the following, I'd like to share more on our financial performance for the year. Despite the supply chain disruption and the market difficulties brought by COVID-19, we still delivered strong results in the year with a steady growth from all four quarters.
[Non-English content] Lisa. [Non-English content]. Our full year revenue grew 17.4% to RMB 1.2 billion, with notable increase in revenue from online marketing and information service. Gross profit was RMB 242.7 million, up 29.6% from the fiscal year 2021.
Gross margin driven by the increasing product GPM and growing contributions from online marketing and information service was 20.5%, up by 200 basis points.
[Non-English content]. Our total sales and marketing expenses were RMB171 million, up by 6.7% from RMB162.6 million.
Sales and marketing expenses as a percentage of total revenue was 14.4%, down from 15.8% from last year, mainly due to the lower customer acquisition cost enjoyed from the growing revenue contributions of Boqii Mall, as well as the adoption of more cost efficient channels across our marketing initiatives.[Non-English content]. Fulfillment expenses slightly increased to CNY 134 million, compared to CNY 120.2 million in last fiscal year.
Fulfillment expenses as a percentage of revenue was 11.3%, down from 11.9% in the fiscal year 2021. Mainly due to the improved utilization of warehouses and lower delivery service price through renegotiation with third-party service providers. As a result, post-fulfillment margin increased to 9.2% compared to 6.6% in last year.
[Non-English content]. General and administrative expenses were RMB76.2 million, down by 33.1% from RMB114 million in fiscal year 2021.
General and administrative expenses as a percentage of total revenue was 6.4%, down from 11.3% in fiscal year 2021. The decrease was mainly due to lower share SBC expenses of RMB 11.7 million, compared to RMB 42.1 million in the last fiscal year. With all the above, that has led to a narrowing adjusted net loss for the year of RMB 121.2 million, versus RMB 149.6 million last year. As mentioned by Lisa, we are confident of a break even in the coming quarters.
[Non-English content]
[Non-English content]. On our financial position as of 31 March 2022, if excluding the RMB 181 million of long-term debt, our effective debt-to-asset ratio stood at 44.8%.
As we are in the progress of completing shareholders' ODI, the company is expected to receive the equivalent amount in US dollars from overseas, which will be recorded in equity after repaying the RMB 181 million of long-term debt. With no major CapEx foresight and a strong credit line backup, we believe we are cash sufficient to support our operation and pursue new initiatives, especially with our CAC achieving new low end as we get closer to our break-even point.
[Non-English content]. Operationally, to expand our business scope and provide all-rounded services to our branded partners and pet parents, we actively explored collaboration opportunities during the year.
We have established a strategic partnership with E-vet Software, one of the leading pet hospital SaaS companies, covering over 3,500 pet hospitals, to provide hospitals with convenient tools such as online medical services, membership management, notification and reminder, and event promotion. Supported by our strong supply chain capability, we were able to transform the procurement system of hospitals, moving them from less reputable and possibly unreliable supplier to our well-guarded and reliable platform.
We believe the collaboration will establish a new standard for professional and personalized pet medical services, and it will provide strong support for our product sales business. [Non-English content]. On the other hand, we also made progress in the strategic partnerships with industry partners, including [Non-English content], to provide customized pet-friendly staycation experience under the Blossom House brand.
Fashion brands to offer cross-over products as well as commercial property companies such as BSC, the MixC, and CRC to co-host pet events.
We have also entered the cooperation into the entertainment industry by collaborating with [Non-English content].
[Non-English content] Over the years, thanks to our five million spending customers, we have achieved these excellent results. In the upcoming quarters, we expect the trend to continue long into the future. As we further expand our portfolio offerings, strengthen our supply chain, and establish more multi-experience touch points, we believe the strong growth momentum in active buyers and post-fulfillment margin will make us stand out in the increasingly challenging pet market. [Non-English content].
In the meantime of business growth, we will also continue our mission of caring for pets to the best of our ability, whether it is by product sales to our pet parents, marketing service to our branded partners, or community service and donations to those in need.
We will also stay vigilant to the changing dynamic in our industry in order to best serve our pet owners and industry partners in order to generate a fruitful return to our shareholders. [Non-English content].
Let's now move on to the Q&A section.
Operator
Ladies and gentlemen, at this time we'll begin the question-and-answer session. To ask a question, you may press star and then one. To remove yourself from the question queue, you may press star, then two. If you are using a speakerphone, we do ask you please pick up the handset prior to pressing the numbers to ensure the best sound quality. Once again, that is star and then one to join the question queue.
Our first question today comes from Darren Aftahi from Roth Capital Partners. Please go ahead with your question.
Darren Aftahi
Managing Director and Senior Research Analyst, ROTH Capital Partners
Hi, thanks for taking my question and good evening. I'm just kinda curious if you could maybe try and quantify how bad COVID impacted your business during the quarter. Post March, how has that changed?
Mandy Luo
Investor Relations Manager, Boqii Holding
Darren, thank you for your question. Actually, as you all know, Shanghai's pandemic started from early March, and that has really impacted the supply chain and the pet supply chain as well. It was not like the situation back in 2020, and we did see some influences. However, during the pandemic, we also developed a new way to connect with our customers. We used group buy, as mentioned in the earnings call, that has made up for some of the sales drops. Still, we saw some influence from the pandemic. On the other hand, we're also seeing that the pandemic hurt the offline scenario even harder, and that might have longer influences.
Still, during this time, we see the online demand is still there. If we can find a solution to the logistics and the supply chain block, which is also what we are doing right now, we believe we can offset this influence in some time, and that will not hurt our overall sales.
Darren Aftahi
Managing Director and Senior Research Analyst, ROTH Capital Partners
Great. A couple more, if I may. You touched on your membership program. I'm just kinda curious. Could you give any general sense for the level of spend of members versus non-members in the quarter?
Louis Liang
Chairman and CEO, Boqii Holding
Hi, Darren. Hi. Sorry, I was dropped off, like, accidentally due to some bad signal. Regarding the membership program, yes, we are still seeing the same pattern with the member versus non-member spending. In general, the members spending about kind of 3x over the non-members over the same quarter. In terms of both the RP and T as well as the margin contribution. We see some like kind of little bit flat in terms of like growth rate, which means they're kind of still the same growth rate, but now we can see kind of acceleration of the growth rate in terms of adding the members, mainly due to that, as we mentioned earlier.
For the membership program, it's not only about online discount, it's more about kind of many other multiple offline plus online benefit to the members. On that front, we're still working hard. One number could definitely reflect how strong, like, our brand recognition is, like with our members, would be our CAC cost dropped dramatically from the 12-ish to the RMB 5.7 per customers. That would include in the non-members. Average that out, you will see, like, how well our membership programs are.
Darren Aftahi
Managing Director and Senior Research Analyst, ROTH Capital Partners
Great. Two more for me. One, what level of revenue gets you to adjusted EBITDA breakeven? I may have asked this on the last call, but just given where your stock is and your cash position, what are your general thoughts about a shareholder buyback plan? Thanks.
Louis Liang
Chairman and CEO, Boqii Holding
Okay. Maybe I'll just, before we jump into the detailed financial numbers, kind of touch upon the buyback plan. Yeah, definitely we are open for the buyback plan, and it's in our war chest. Given the current market condition, we think it's like a falling knife in terms of the ADRs in general. Therefore, we will deliberately choose the best timing that serves the company best for the buyback. We are not rushing to market, but definitely it's in our war chest.
Kai Fang
Chief Strategy Officer, Boqii Holding
Darren, one point to add is that we expect that, when our quarterly revenue achieve between CNY 350 million and 400 million. Meanwhile, when our GPM reach 25% and we will achieve breakeven maybe in the Q4 or the Q3.
Darren Aftahi
Managing Director and Senior Research Analyst, ROTH Capital Partners
Great. Thank you, Louis Liang.
Operator
Once again, if you would like to ask a question, please press star and one. To withdraw your questions, you may press star and two. Ladies and gentlemen, at this time I'm showing no additional questions. I'd like to turn the floor back over to management for any closing remarks.
Lisa Tang
Co-Chief Executive Officer and CFO, Boqii Holding
[Non-English content]
Mandy Luo
Investor Relations Manager, Boqii Holding
Hi, Darren, and hi, investors. Lisa just made some final remarks regarding the questions from some retail investors. I believe that will be the end of our sharing today, and thank you for your time and attention. We'd like to see you in the next call as well.
Operator
Ladies and gentlemen, that will conclude today's presentation. We do thank you for joining. You may now disconnect your lines.
